title: Divider
description: Une fine ligne qui sépare du contenu, horizontalement ou verticalement, éventuellement avec du texte.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line thickness in dp (1 renders a device hairline)

props.name: spacing
props.description: Margin around the divider in dp (top / bottom when horizontal, left / right when vertical)

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)

props.name: textAlign
props.description: Position of the text of a horizontal divider

vars.name: --divider-spacing

vars.name: --divider-text-gap
vars.description: Space between the text and the lines
